verdict.rationale: The evidence pack contains no spec sheet for the Core Ultra 7 258V: no clock speeds, power figures, memory support, or test conditions. The only number is a family-level "up to 48 TOPS NPU" headline for Series 2. Everything else is marketing language ("lightning speed", "ultra-smooth FPS"), which is what this story wants to avoid. A single unqualified "up to" figure with no test conditions does not show that Intel publishes the per-SKU spec sheet the story asks for.

support.subject: As a power-user, I can comparison-shop from a real spec sheet — the vendor publishes clocks, power, memory support, and AI TOPS with test conditions, instead of marketing adjectives
